issues.title: ICE Accountability in Minneapolis
issues.summary: The metro surge is ending but accountability is just beginning. Demand justice for Renee and Alex, an end to racial profiling, and community reparations.

issues.title: Digital Privacy & Government Surveillance
issues.summary: Federal agents are tracking phones, photographing faces, and revoking travel privileges. Demand GDPR-style protections.

issues.title: Protect the Boundary Waters from Mining
issues.summary: Congress is voting to lift a 20-year mining ban near the BWCA. A Chilean-owned company wants to build a copper-nickel mine next to America's most pristine wilderness.
